_comment: Golden cases: a description in, an exact formula out.
This file is the regression net for a rules engine. Every new keyword in
the knowledge base can steal a match from an existing one, and nothing
else will tell you. Add a case here before fixing a bug, so the fix is
`table` names one of the fixtures in test_golden.py. `formula` must match
exactly, separators included — that is the point.
Cases marked "expect": "template" assert the engine correctly declines
to guess, which matters as much as the cases it answers.
